import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

fe_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
sal_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
cc_df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Normalize cost centre lookup
cc_df['cc_norm'] = cc_df['Cost Centre Code'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
lookup = cc_df[['cc_norm', 'Programme']].copy()

# Field Expenses processing
fe_df['Transaction ID'] = fe_df['Transaction ID'].astype(str)
fe_df['Posting Status'] = fe_df['Posting Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_df['Cost Centre Norm'] = fe_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
fe_df['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(fe_df['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')

fe_filtered = fe_df[
    fe_df['Transaction ID'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (fe_df['Posting Status'] == 'posted')
].copy()

# Merge with lookup
fe_merged = fe_filtered.merge(lookup, left_on='Cost Centre Norm', right_on='cc_norm', how='inner')
print('FE merged rows', len(fe_merged))
print(fe_merged[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Cost Centre Norm','Programme','Amount (INR)']].head())

# Salary processing
sal_df['Payroll Line ID'] = sal_df['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str)
sal_df['Payroll Status'] = sal_df['Payroll Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sal_df['Cost Centre Norm'] = sal_df['Cost Centre'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
sal_df['Gross Salary (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(sal_df['Gross Salary (INR)'], errors='coerce')

sal_filtered = sal_df[
    sal_df['Payroll Line ID'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (sal_df['Payroll Status'] == 'paid')
].copy()

sal_merged = sal_filtered.merge(lookup, left_on='Cost Centre Norm', right_on='cc_norm', how='inner')
print('Salary merged rows', len(sal_merged))
print(sal_merged[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Cost Centre Norm','Programme','Gross Salary (INR)']].head())

# Sum per programme
fe_sum = fe_merged.groupby('Programme')['Amount (INR)'].sum()
sal_sum = sal_merged.groupby('Programme')['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()

combined = pd.DataFrame({
    'Field_Expenses': fe_sum,
    'Salary': sal_sum
}).fillna(0)
combined['Combined'] = combined['Field_Expenses'] + combined['Salary']
print(combined.sort_values('Combined', ascending=False))

# Identify top programme
top_prog = combined['Combined'].idxmax()
top_amount = combined.loc[top_prog, 'Combined']
print('Top programme:', top_prog, top_amount)

        return None
    s = str(x)

        return float(s)
